tagline: Brussels Digital Arts Web Audio Transmissions

footer.aboutLine: Artists-run transmissions and audio recordings from Hectolitre, Brussels.
footer.credit: Radio Hectolitre is an internet art radio broadcast by Chris A. Iradukunda (daqhris), artist-in-residence at Hectolitre where the sound works originate.

social.defaultImageAlt: Documentation photo from the first Radio Hectolitre transmission: people gathered around a laptop and a spherical metal sculpture on a stand, at Hectolitre in Brussels
